newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-MIDDLESBROUGH TURN DOWN BAKERO AFTER TRIAL.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-MIDDLESBROUGH TURN DOWN BAKERO AFTER TRIAL.

text.p: Former Spanish captain Jose Bakero has been turned down by Middlesbrough after a three-week trial at the English first division club.
"Bakero has not been offered a contract by the Boro after a trial spell," the club said on Friday.
Manager Bryan Robson had said earlier in the month that the 33-year-old former Barcelona midfielder was likely to get a permanent contract at the newly-relegated club.
Bakero was released on a free transfer by Mexican club Veracruz and is seeking to return to Europe.
Middlesbrough are in the process of rebuilding their squad to try and secure an immediate return to the premier league.
